text: Eating well, staying active, and getting enough rest are the foundations of a healthy life. A balanced diet with fruits, vegetables, and whole grains gives your body energy, while regular exercise—even a daily walk—strengthens your heart and muscles. However, health isn’t only physical. Sleep is crucial for your brain to recharge, and seven to nine hours each night helps you focus and feel positive. Equally important is mental health: taking time to relax, talk to friends, or practice mindfulness can reduce stress. Finally, a good work-life balance means setting boundaries between work and personal time, so you have space for hobbies and family. By caring for your body and mind together, you can enjoy a more energetic and fulfilling life.
